"''I am inclined to agree.|Arihnda Pryce and Wilhuff Tarkin discuss a rebel operation at the Naraka prison|}} '''Naraka''' was a [[Stone|rocky]] and hazy [[planet]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. During the [[Imperial Era]], it was controlled by the [[Galactic Empire]], who maintained a [[Naraka prison|prison]] there. In [[2 BBY]], the [[Phoenix Cell|rebel]] team known as the [[Spectres]] traveled to Naraka to [[Rescue of Hondo Ohnaka|rescue]] the [[pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka]] from the [[prison]]. ==Description== Naraka was a terrestrial [[planet]] with a breathable type I [[atmosphere]]. A world of haze and [[Stone|rock]], it was located in the [[Naraka system]] and within the [[Phelleem sector]]. It lay at grid square S-7 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]], within the [[Outer Rim Territories]] and [[the Slice]] regions, and along the [[Triellus Trade Route]]. ==History== {{Quote|I still can't believe we're here to break ''this'' guy out of prison.|Sabine Wren remarks about the Spectres' mission to free Hondo Ohnaka from prison on Naraka|}} [[File:Steps_Into_Shadow_thumb.png|thumb|left|275px|Ezra and the rescue team freeing Ohnaka]] During the [[Imperial Era]], the [[Galactic Empire]] constructed a [[Naraka prison|prison]] on Naraka. At some point after meeting members of the [[Phoenix Cell|rebel]] team known as the [[Spectres]] at [[Nixus Hub 218]]{{Rebels|Legends of the Lasat}} in [[3 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' the [[pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka]] found himself in the [[Prisoner|custody]] of the Empire, incarcerated in Naraka [[prison]] alongside his [[Ugnaught]] companion [[Terba]]. In [[2 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[Steps Into Shadow]]" to [[2 BBY]]. the Spectres traveled to Naraka in their [[VCX-100 light freighter|starship]], the ''[[Ghost]]'', to [[Rescue of Hondo Ohnaka|rescue]] Ohnaka from Naraka prison, as the rebels believed Ohnaka had more information to offer them. Several of the Spectres, namely [[Ezra Bridger]], [[Garazeb Orrelios]], [[Sabine Wren]], and [[C1-10P|Chopper]], infiltrated the prison and located Ohnaka in his [[6609|cell]]. Although the rebels had been unaware of Terba's presence, they freed both individuals and prepared to make their escape. However, the group was quickly intercepted by [[stormtrooper]]s and began to fight their way toward the single landing pad that extended from the prison, with Bridger contacting their leader{{Rebels|Spark of Rebellion}} [[Hera Syndulla]] to request a [[44 scoop|pickup]]. However, as the team arrived at the landing platform, Terba was [[Death|killed]] by an [[All Terrain Defense Pod|AT-DP walker]] and the others were pinned down by the [[AT-series|walker]] and several stormtroopers. Bridger took matters into his own hands, using [[Mind trick|mind control]] on the [[Imperial combat driver|walker's driver]] and forcing them to fire on their allies before walking off the platform. Wren, Orrelios, and Ohnaka were stunned by the brutality of the stunt. Syndulla then arrived in the ''Ghost'', and the team successfully escaped, securing the intel Ohnaka possessed about Imperial activities on the planet [[Yarma]]. Following the escape, Imperial officials, namely [[Governor of the Lothal sector|Governor]] [[Arihnda Pryce]], [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]], and later, [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]], discussed the incident as well as the rebels who perpetrated the breakout. ==Locations== {{Quote|I knew you would not let your old partner, Hondo, rot away in this prison.|Hondo Ohnaka, to Ezra Bridger|}} [[File:Ezra_controls_the_AT-DP.png|thumb|right|250px|The landing platform at Naraka prison]] Naraka prison was built into the planet and protruded from the face of a cliff, with the only entrance being a single landing platform. This made any potential escapes particularly difficult. ==Behind the scenes== Naraka first appeared and was identified in "[[Steps Into Shadow]]", the premiere of the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Three|third season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'', which premiered on [[September 24]], 2016.{{SW|url=news/the-rebels-face-grand-admiral-thrawn-when-star-wars-rebels-season-three-premieres-saturday-september-24|text=The Rebels Face Grand Admiral Thrawn When ''Star Wars Rebels'' Season Three Premieres Saturday, September 24}} Prior to the episode's release, the planet was first depicted in an episode of the behind-the-scenes series ''[[The Star Wars Show]]'', released on the official ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Wikipedia:YouTube|YouTube]] channel on [[July 13]] of that year.{{StarWarsShow|Qe3LSQiMJUk|Star Wars Rebels Season 3 Clip, Gareth Edwards Interview, and More!|sw_url=video/the-star-wars-show-episode-10}} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Naraka}} *{{Rebels|Steps Into Shadow}} {{1st}} {{1stID|Naraka}} ==Sources== *{{StarWarsShow|Qe3LSQiMJUk|Star Wars Rebels Season 3 Clip, Gareth Edwards Interview, and More!|sw_url=video/the-star-wars-show-episode-10}} {{1stp}} {{Video}} *{{SWYouTube|xmXp802sFgQ|Star Wars Rebels Season Three Trailer (Official)|sw_url=video/star-wars-rebels-season-three-trailer}} {{Video}} *{{SWYouTube|kipQR6NcbEc|Mind Trick -
